h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nagaland

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nagaland

c: Nagaland has two quite different kinds of site. Kohima and the other hill towns are cool, steep and wet, while Dimapur sits on the plains and is warmer, flatter and busier. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment to both. We plan each layout around the ground you have, and the machine list changes with the site. Mokokchung, Wokha and other district towns follow the hill pattern of Kohima.

Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, and sent to Nagaland by road. A local dealer or our own team installs them, grouted or self-standing. Typical buyers are schools, colleges, churches, town councils, government departments and sports bodies. If you already have a playing field, a row of stations along one side is often the simplest way to begin. Share a sketch with the field's length and width and we will mark where each machine goes.

richText.heading: Hill towns and the Dimapur plains

c: In Kohima, cut level pads for each station and give them drainage on the uphill side, since the monsoon brings heavy rain down the slopes. In Dimapur there is more flat ground, but summer afternoons are hot and humid, so shade matters more than slope. Plant trees on the west side of the gym or plan a simple shed so the afternoon sun does not heat the handles.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gym equipment to Dimapur?
items.a: Yes. Dimapur and Kohima are both covered. The equipment is sent from our Vasai factory by road and installed by our team or a dealer in the region. Tell us the road access to your site when you share the photos.

items.q: Which machine lets the most people exercise at once?
items.a: Multi-user stations such as the Seating Twister Three Way or the 6 Station Multi Gym let several people train together on one frame. They save space on crowded grounds.

items.q: What maintenance does an outdoor gym need in the hills?
items.a: Check bolts and bearings after the monsoon, clear leaves and mud from the base, and report any worn part to our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921.
